Family Dashboard (phone) calendar: just Month and Week (no 🎂 or 🌴), short day names in portrait, Today and the views on the left, Key and + Add on the right
Family Dashboard (phone): a small ⓘ at the end of the top row opens About & diagnostics, laid out for the phone

Family Admin (phone): More → About and diagnostics, with the versions, this phone, and a report you can share or email
Family Admin (phone): the browser tab says HouseRunner – Family Admin App

Family Admin: Rewards has Configure (Reward Tasks, Daily To-Dos, Reminder Display, reward rules, manual adjustments – as on the computer) and View (each child, fully open)

My data (Google): step-by-step for freeing your licence key before starting again from scratch, and ‘Copy everything to a fresh Sheet’ named so it isn’t confused with starting again

Widget settings pop-up: a normal-sized icon in the title, and the description set apart from the settings

Menu: solid, colourful icons throughout – 📺 Screens and 🧰 System replace the thin screen and spanner – each icon sits closer to its own word, with clearer space between items.

Consistency check across the whole system: the same names everywhere – the Configurator, Family Admin, the Family Dashboard app, ⚙ Setup → System → …, ⚙ Widgets → …, and “dashboard link” – in Help, the setup wizard, the dashboard’s messages, the privacy notice and the Google script’s messages.
Phone: the daily to-dos’ day pickers fit the screen.

New: the Family Dashboard phone app – the dashboard itself on a phone. It opens on the calendar (the week, as a list of days when the phone is upright) and turns with the phone. Phones don’t count as screens on your licence.

It replaces the Family Calendar app: houserunner.app/calendar now opens the Family Dashboard app, and you add events from its calendar. Install it from ⚙ Setup → System → Devices and Phones, or Home → Connect a new phone. New icons: Family Admin has a cog, Family Dashboard a green dashboard badge.

The menu: “Advanced” is now “System” (🔧), so the ⚙ cogs only mark the Setup and Widgets groups. Every menu item has a coloured icon – grey until it’s the page you’re on, with white words – and when the window is narrow the menu leaves room for its scroll bar.

Family Admin on a phone now has the same pages as the Configurator, laid out for a phone: Home, ⚙ Setup (Family, Rewards, Advanced) and ⚙ Widgets (Calendar, Notes, Lists, Reminders, Other), in a menu along the top. A small HouseRunner ⚙ mark replaces the title, with ▶ Dashboard, 💬 and ❓ beside it.

Wording tidied everywhere to match the menus – ⚙ Setup → Advanced → External data keys, Devices and Phones, and so on – in Help, the screen’s messages and the Google script’s messages.

Traffic: when there are no journeys set up, or none is due at this time, the widget shows a live traffic map around home instead, filling the widget. How far it reaches is a new setting – “Area map: distance from home” – 30 miles to start with.

⚙ Widgets → Calendar is now simple and practical: a form to add an event (what, who or what for, the day or days, a time, notes) and a list of everything coming up in the next five weeks, each with ✕ to delete it. The full calendar – week, month and year – is on the dashboard.
⚙ Widgets → Other is now laid out like Rewards: every widget down the left – grouped into Information, Everything else and Not in use – and its settings on the right when you click it.

A widget that’s on your screens more than once is listed once for each copy, numbered in the order they appear (Photo slideshow 1, Photo slideshow 2), because each copy has its own settings. “How widgets work”, at the top of the list, explains this.
The Configurator’s menu now reads ⚙ Setup and ⚙ Widgets (Calendar, Notes, Lists, Reminders, Other) – “Widgets” everywhere instead of “Apps”.
A green ▶ View dashboard button at the top of the Configurator and the setup wizard opens the dashboard itself.
The dashboard’s address is now houserunner.app/dashboard. The old …/screen address still works and forwards there, so screens already set up carry on as they are.
Connect this device pop-up: scanning the QR code is marked best on Android; typing the code in the Family Admin app is the way that always works, including on iPhone.

Welcome page: two clear buttons – Start new setup, and Already have HouseRunner – Connect this device. The second opens a pop-up with the 8-character code and a QR code to scan with a phone that’s already connected; it closes by itself and opens HouseRunner as soon as the phone connects it.

Starting a new setup leaves any earlier setups in your Google account untouched – the page now says so. The “start again” and “move account” options have gone from the welcome page: connect this device first, then do those from Setup.
Disconnect now really disconnects: it forgets the family everywhere on that device (including the setup wizard’s copy, which used to connect it straight back), and shows the welcome page.
If the family’s Google Sheet can’t be reached, houserunner.app says so – with Try again and Disconnect – instead of showing “Loading…” for ever.
The “Family Admin” label no longer appears in the title bar: it’s HouseRunner everywhere.

houserunner.app is now the app itself. On a computer it’s the Configurator; on a phone it’s Family Admin; on a device that isn’t connected yet it’s a welcome page for new families – what HouseRunner does, how it works, what you need, and Start setup.

The addresses are now: houserunner.app, houserunner.app/calendar (Family Calendar), houserunner.app/screen (the dashboard), houserunner.app/windows (the Windows start file) and houserunner.app/licencing. Old links – …/setup, …/admin and the old GitHub address – still work and forward to the right place.

Configurator Home: two new sections at the bottom – Connect a new display (Corsair XENEON EDGE, Raspberry Pi, tablet, any computer) and Connect a new phone (QR codes for Family Admin and Family Calendar).
The links email now has one link for the Configurator and Family Admin. Phones with the old Family Admin icon: it still works – or add houserunner.app to the home screen instead.

Home page: on a device that’s already connected, the big panel of links is replaced by one simple line – “You’re connected to the [your family name] family dashboard” – with Open Setup and Disconnect this browser.
The houserunner.app home page now has the same title bar as the Configurator – the HouseRunner logo and name on the left, Help on the right – and a “Welcome to HouseRunner” heading.
Version numbers are much quieter on the home page: a small grey note at the bottom, and What’s new just lists the changes.
HouseRunner has its own web address: houserunner.app (houserunner.net goes there too). The screen, the phone apps, the Configurator, Help and the licence emails all use it now.

Nothing to do: the next time each screen, phone or computer opens the old address, it carries its connection across to houserunner.app by itself. Phones: if you’d added Family Admin or Family Calendar to your home screen, add them again from the new address so the icon opens it directly.
Your Google script follows the website to the new address by itself, and keeps updating as before.
The HouseRunner logo in the title bars now sits level with the name – the house rests on the same line as the letters, whatever font your computer uses – with a smaller gap between them.
The HouseRunner logo in the Configurator and setup wizard title bars is slightly bigger, sits closer to the name, and is centred on it.

Family Admin and Family Calendar now carry the HouseRunner brand, quietly: a small house-and-lines logo by the title at the top, and “HouseRunner – a family dashboard” in the small print (More in Family Admin, the ⚙ sheet in Family Calendar, and the screen where you first connect the app).
Nothing has changed on the dashboard screen.
The title bar at the top of the Configurator and the setup wizard now just says HouseRunner, with the logo – the word “Configurator” has gone from it.
The HouseRunner logo’s three coloured lines are longer and thicker, so they show up properly at small sizes.

Family Admin and Family Calendar have new app icons: the HouseRunner house and lines, with a blue cog for Admin and an amber calendar for Calendar. A phone that already has the apps on its home screen may keep the old icon until the app is removed and added again.

Fixed: on the Configurator, the new HouseRunner logo and name in the title bar were stacked on top of each other and cut off (only “House” showed). They are back on one line: logo, HouseRunner Configurator.

Setup wizard: making your Google Sheet and switching it on are now one continuous set of steps, all done in the new tab. You no longer come back to the wizard in between – “Carry on with setup” in your Sheet picks up straight after, already connected.
Your new Sheet renames itself from “Copy of Family Dashboard” to “Family Dashboard” the first time it’s set up.

The website has a new name and logo: HouseRunner – a family dashboard. It is on the home page, the Configurator, the setup wizard, Help, What’s new and the other pages, with a new icon in the browser tab.
On the screen, the status panel (tap the version number) now shows the HouseRunner name and logo. Nothing else on the screen has changed.

Some names stay as they were for now, because they live in your Google Sheet and emails: the Sheet’s “Family Dashboard” menu, the “Your Family Dashboard links” email, the “Start Family Dashboard” file, and the Family Admin and Family Calendar apps.

If a browser is set to block websites from saving anything (“Block all cookies”, a private window, or clearing site data every time), the Configurator, the wizard and the phone apps now say so in a red bar at the top, with how to fix it. A short, plain-English licence agreement is now on the website (licence.html), linked from the home page, the Software Licence page and the wizard’s licence step.
The licence email now comes with the licence agreement attached as a PDF, with a link to the online copy.

Your country now fills in how dates work: the day weeks start on (Monday or Sunday) and how dates are written (14 Nov or Nov 14), as well as the currency and time zone. You can change any of them in Advanced → Locations & home, or in the wizard’s family step.
The calendars on the screen and in the Family Calendar app start their weeks on your chosen day, and dates everywhere follow your chosen order.

A backup of your private links: the setup wizard emails them to your Google account (“Your Family Dashboard links – keep this email”) as soon as it connects, and again whenever the access code changes.
